    Profile

    Hazuki is the granddaughter of a Jokai Grade Shinto Priest from Wadatsumi. She has the abilities of a spirit medium as well. She can channel not only human spirits, but also those of plants and animals—her specialty. That's why she gets along well with Rin the wolf girl. They've often been yelled at for causing mischief together.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Female
    Height: 150cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Aug 25
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: New things
    Hobbies: Mischief
    Illust: ―
    CV: 中村紗彩
